author: CBR
description:
Jason Aaron breaks down a truth every creator learns: it’s okay to say no, and the “this is my only shot” fear is usually wrong. But he explains why the Absolute Universe was a rare exception, and why getting to write a brand-new continuity version of Superman was impossible to turn down. 

🎙️ Clip from CBR’s Heroes Journey Podcast – Episode 14.
